opinions.text: C. A. 7th Cir. [Certiorari granted, ante, p. 938.] Motion of the Acting Solicitor General for leave to participate in oral argument as amicus curiae granted and 15 minutes allotted for that purpose. Counsel for petitioners allotted an additional 15 minutes for oral argument. Motion of the State of Alabama et al. for leave to participate in oral argument as amici curiae denied.
